assertions.text: Agent file has valid frontmatter with name, description, model, and color fields
tools field (if present) is restricted to Read/Grep/Glob only, with no Write/Edit/Bash
description field is a single sentence with no verbose <example> blocks
Body includes a '## When to invoke' section with 2-4 prose trigger scenarios
name field is lowercase-hyphenated, 3-50 characters, starts/ends alphanumeric
